shared_rules.upper_request: capacity + max(256, capacity * spare_fraction), clamped to max_size

selection: Require at least 75% captured peak reduction on whitespace-trailing-16384 versus current.
Require long-ascii-4096 captured peak no more than 20% above current.
Among eligible candidates compare equal-weight geometric mean parse times over all training inputs.
Treat differences within 5% of the best geometric mean as ties; break ties by lower total logical token relocation bytes.
Record every input's regressions; the preset is not a promise of lower total peak on every document.

holdout.generation: Only after candidate selection has been recorded.
holdout.policy: Evaluate the selected candidate only; do not retune on this split.
